messages:
Maya Gupta: FYI getting a handful of reports that new hires aren't getting the 'engineer' role after SSO login. Started ~10:30 UTC after we pushed the role-attribute cleanup.
Kevin Lu: ack, can you paste an example user id / assertion?
Maya Gupta: user: snewton@redwood.ai. Okta logs show a successful SAML assertion but no roles claim present. Seems JIT provisioning still runs but role assignment is empty.
Okta Bot: SAML Assertion for snewton@redwood.ai: 
```xml
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="roles">
    <!-- missing -->
  </Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="email">snewton@redwood.ai</Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```
Aditya Rao: ugh, did the attr rename go live? I remember the mapping PR renamed `roles` -> `app_roles` to avoid collisions.
Maya Gupta: right, PR #5423 switched the App integration mapping to `app_roles`, but the JIT role lookup still expects `roles`.
Sarah Patel: I saw this in support queue too, ~6 tickets. Most are new users created in last 12h.
Kevin Lu: quick mitigation: update the JIT mapper to fallback to `app_roles` if `roles` missing, then backfill. Is that safe?
Aditya Rao: yes safe for short term. But we should be careful: `app_roles` was introduced to carry multiple app-scoped roles, format is comma-separated strings. Current parser expects JSON array.
Maya Gupta: example failure from our logs: `role-parse: invalid token at position 1`, coming from the JSON.parse in role_assigner.
Ops Oncall: I'll flip a feature flag to enable fallback behavior for the JIT path, and add a metric to count mismatches.
Kevin Lu: for backfill we can run a job that reads recent SAML events and updates account roles where missing. I can own a small DB migration script.
Sarah Patel: also need audit entries for any automatic role assignment changes. Compliance wants a record of the original assertion and assignment delta.
Maya Gupta: Agreed. Proposed action list: 1) flip JIT fallback flag to prefer `roles` then `app_roles` (Ops Oncall), 2) Kevin to run backfill job for last 48h, 3) Aditya to update parser to accept both CSV and JSON arrays, 4) create audit log entry for every assignment change (Maya/Sarah).
Aditya Rao: I'll open a small PR for parser + unit tests, target deploy in next 2 hours.
Kevin Lu: backfill plan: select users where role is null and there is a SAML event in events table within 48h, parse assertion for `roles` or `app_roles`, write assignment change to `role_audit` table. I'll tag Sarah on the migration SQL.
Sarah Patel: please include the Okta event id and raw assertion in `role_audit.raw_assertion`. Mask PII except the email.
Maya Gupta: note: customer-facing role fallback should be temporary. We need to revert mapping or standardize on `roles` across the pipeline. Long term: update the App integration mapping doc and notify SSO integrators.
Aditya Rao: also found one edge-case: some assertions include `roles` as a single string with semicolon-separated values. I'll normalize separators (comma/semicolon) in parser.
Ops Oncall: flipped flag `jit_role_fallback=true` at 1778123800. Metric `sso.role_claim_missing` spiked to 27 after that.
Okta Bot: Audit event 8b7f3: provisioning succeeded for snewton@redwood.ai with assigned roles ["engineer"].
Maya Gupta: good. Kevin, can you post the migration SQL when ready so security can review?
Kevin Lu: will do. Draft SQL: 
```sql
INSERT INTO role_audit (user_id, okta_event_id, raw_assertion, old_roles, new_roles, created_at)
SELECT u.id, e.id, e.raw_assertion, u.roles, parsed_roles, now()
FROM users u
JOIN sso_events e ON e.email = u.email
WHERE u.roles IS NULL AND e.created_at > now() - interval '48 hours';
```
Maya Gupta: thanks. Sarah, I'll coordinate the compliance note and send a brief to support ops about which accounts were affected.
Sarah Patel: tracked in ticket SEC-721. Please add the list of users to the ticket thread when backfill is done.
Aditya Rao: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5489 (parser + tests).
Kevin Lu: backfill run scheduled at 1778124100, will watch and report failures.
Maya Gupta: closing loop: turning this into a short postmortem and a doc update for the SSO attribute contract. Adding owner: Aditya for normalization + Maya for communication.
Sarah Patel: :thumbsup:  thanks everyone, follow-ups tracked in SEC-721 and PR 5489.
